prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app concept for the Terrazza CRM Negócios Kanban, 1536x1024 landscape.
Primary request: Design direction A, "Trilho Operacional": a modern, production-realistic six-stage horizontal Kanban for real-estate deals. Preserve the established Terrazza identity from the reference logo: deep navy #071E36, warm ivory #F7F3ED, restrained gold #C89B3C, white surfaces, warm beige borders #E8DDCB, professional Brazilian Portuguese operational interface.
Structure: fixed dark navy left sidebar; compact page header "Negócios" with breadcrumb and primary action; compact KPI strip preserving Negócios ativos, Estruturação, Proposta, Negociação, Documentos e contrato, Previsão comercial; filter toolbar with toggle "Meus negócios / Todos"; below, a dominant horizontally scrollable board with six narrow columns: Estruturação, Proposta, Negociação, Documentação, Contrato, Assinatura.
Column headers: stage name, count, total value, stalled count. Deal cards: title, type, lead, property, responsible person, commercial value, forecast, stalled badge in amber/red, small dedicated dotted drag handle. Show one card actively being dragged from Proposta toward adjacent Negociação; only the valid adjacent target has a subtle gold outline and drop zone, non-adjacent columns look inactive.
Visual thesis: compact executive operations rail, strong scanability, moderate density, crisp alignment, subtle shadows, restrained state color. Cards are not giant rounded tiles. The board is the focal point.
Text (verbatim where legible): "Negócios", "Meus negócios", "Todos", "Estruturação", "Proposta", "Negociação", "Documentação", "Contrato", "Assinatura", "Parado há 11 dias", "R$ 850.000".
Constraints: desktop CRM UI, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no decorative illustration, no invented analytics, no charts, no drag between non-adjacent stages, no mouse cursor, no watermark. Use the reference only for palette and brand character; do not reproduce the large logo panel or marketing content.
